_: Anchor on the roadmap -> the issue number that tracks it. Written by
scripts/seed-issues.mjs, and appended by hand when a new section is added and
filed. scripts/roadmap-data.mjs renders each number as a link on its section,
so the page and the tracker point at each other.
The keys are content slugs, never positions. A backlog section's §number is only
where it currently sits in the priority order and moves whenever I reorder the
page; the issue number is fixed for its life. Keying this file on the position
